description: This file defines interfaces and classes for inter-process communication (IPC) within the WPEFramework core namespace. It includes message serialization/deserialization, IPC channel management, and related classes for handling IPC messages, servers, and channels, with specific focus on message types, serialization, and channel link management.

classes.name: IMessage
classes.description: Interface for messages with serialization and deserialization capabilities, including nested Serializer and Deserializer classes.

classes.name: IIPC
classes.description: Interface representing an IPC message with label, parameters, and response.

classes.name: IIPCServer
classes.description: Interface for IPC server procedures handling incoming messages.

classes.name: IPCMessageType<IDENTIFIER, PARAMETERS, RESPONSE>
classes.description: Template class defining specific IPC message types with parameter and response serialization.

classes.name: IPCChannel
classes.description: Abstract class managing IPC channels, registration, invocation, and response reporting.

classes.name: IPCChannelType<ACTUALSOURCE, EXTENSION>
classes.description: Template class extending IPCChannel, managing link and channel state, with nested link and trigger classes for message handling and synchronization.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an IMessage into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into an IMessage.

methods.name: IParameters
methods.description: Returns the message parameters as a ProxyType<IMessage>.

methods.name: IResponse
methods.description: Returns the message response as a ProxyType<IMessage>.
